bagPolicy.summary: Bags are prohibited except small bags no larger than 5 x 8 x 1 inches, medically necessary bags, and reasonably sized diaper bags. Permitted exceptions are subject to inspection.
allowed: Small bags up to 5 x 8 x 1 inches
prohibited: Bags larger than 5 x 8 x 1 inches without an exception
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking and tailgating must remain within designated stalls and travel lanes. Tailgating may occur directly in front of or behind a vehicle; charcoal and open-flame wood grills are prohibited.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
